finding: Bullet hit runs visual, click and camera shake first, then the damage call (BulletComp 133, 143). Knockback is impulse divided by size-squared mass (BulletType 517; PhysicsComp 19, 24). Core logic and core client effects read; server module not read. Adapt (idea): GPL, shape only.

Flash: damage sets full white, decaying over nine ticks (HealthComp 9, 26, 75). Damage over time re-flashes only after 18 ticks (HealthComp 92). Shake is max-merged, capped at 100, decays linearly (Renderer 86, 210-211). Best transferable: keep the max-merge shake and the flash gate. Defects: feedback fires before damage (fix: fire from the server-confirmed hit); shake falloff in world units (fix: divide by camera zoom). No hit-stop found in core.

Note hit: judgement uses latency-corrected time (PlayState 3112-3118). Order: cancellable event, strum confirm, pooled splash with fps jitter, rating popup that rises and fades one beat later (PlayState 3149-3163; NoteSplash 10, 56; PopUpStuff 51, 61, 67). Client half only, Apache code: adapt (idea).

Miss ducks the player voice stem and plays one sound from a pool of three at 0.5-0.6 volume; ghost press is quieter (PlayState 3192-3193, 3235). No hit-time shake, flash, hit-stop or hit sound in play/. Best transferable: miss duck with next-hit restore as the mistake signal. Defects: haptic gain saturates at two lanes (NoteVibrationsHandler 59, 64; fix: gain so four lanes reach full); hold-end reset is a no-op (NoteVibrationsHandler 91; fix: index loop with assignment); sick-health comment says 1.0 percent but value is 1.5 (Constants 476).
